styleLock.direction: clean gentle baby care commerce, soft mint nursery still life and real caregiving moments
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless clean white #FFFFFF field for the packshot and the sealed carton screen, soft mint #EAF3F1 ground for benefit and variant screens, matte warm putty #F4F0E9 board for list and pain-point screens, pale sage plaster #E4EDE9 for the kitchen scene, mint terry #DCEAE6 for the care-mat scene, and one deep spring-teal #2E8C86 field reserved for the closing screen; all grounds stay flat, matte and untextured, no gradients and no stock backdrops
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright high-key soft studio light, key at front-left or upper-left around 5500K, white fill card on the shadow side, gentle wrapping shadows, one real contact shadow under every standing unit, no harsh speculars and no straight-down flash
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte plaster counter tones #EFE7DD, pale beech tray wood, soft cotton terry #DCEAE6 and natural kraft fibre #C8A87C; every surface reads matte, never glossy
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif kept for post-production only; the template renders no lettering at all, every copy slot stays an empty placeholder shape
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons and empty hairline rings in #D8B450, at most one emblem per screen, no filled badge artwork and no seal illustrations
styleLock.presentationRules: the pack keeps the same slight 3/4 or straight-on identity across the set, standing units always grounded by a contact shadow, opened lids always facing the lens, product never covered by hands or props, infant always framed from the neck down or from behind
noDrift: no invented badges, seals or award marks
no rendered lettering, digits or prices inside the image
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean gentle baby care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, soft mint #EAF3F1, matte warm putty #F4F0E9 and one spring-teal accent #2E8C86 with a hairline gold #D8B450 detail; neutral high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, a white fill card and real contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif used only in post, no lettering rendered inside the image; thin single-weight line icons and empty hairline rings; clean high-end baby care product photography mixed with minimal empty infographic frames; stable slight 3/4 or straight-on product identity and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no fabricated badges.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 整箱与一列叠放软包的囤货陈列，左侧成人手托闭眼新生儿；002 牛皮纸箱与白卡箱双版本并列、中间双向箭头与更换包装说明大字；003 手指从掀开的翻盖里掀起单片并配弯曲指示箭头；004 婴儿背影加四行线性图标主张清单；005 婴儿侧脸加四枚圆形认证与推荐类徽章；006 怀抱婴儿侧脸特写、心形标志与功效主张卡；007 两栏六项划删式不含清单加一枚圆形印章；008 双格擦脸与餐后脏污对比；009 换洗台上腿部清洁近景；010 与纸尿裤箱同框的搭配推荐；011 三档堆量阶梯与省钱金额；012 至 014 同一只外箱的三个角度棚拍，箱面含条码与二维码。品类判定：主体为带翻盖软包加整箱的婴儿清洁湿巾，场景全为换洗台与餐椅护理，故 L1 取母婴、L2 取洗护；不取纸尿裤，因尿裤箱仅出现在 010 的搭配位；也不改判家居日用纸品清洁，因画面语言与使用人群全为母婴护理；productFamily 取 beauty 以对齐同 L2 的护理个护视觉。已剥离内容：源品牌字标、系列名、心形标志与全部原文案（各图大字标题、划删词目、双格标题、更换包装承诺语、脚注小字）、认证与推荐类徽章及首位社会证明、功效与资质主张、抽数与包数与档位数字、价格与省钱金额、搭配品类名、条码与二维码与网址、原平台角标与星级；所有主张位统一改为空圈、空胶囊、空行与空标签框等留白证明位，图内不渲染任何文字。婴儿出镜一律改为颈部以下裁切、后侧背影或仅出成人手部，不保留源童模面容与身份。
